title: Gorgeous Home w/3 Full Baths ~ Walkable To Broad!!
description:
Songwriter owned!
Beautiful new renovation located in quaint residential neighborhood.
Five minute Lyft ride or leisurely 1 mile walk to the strip!!
55" LED 4k smart TV with HBO & Netflix.
New appliances, fully stocked kitchen, all bathroom essentials.
Free street parking and space to park in back.
Convenient keypad lock so everyone in your group can come and go as they please =)
Just blocks from Capital View, Farmer's Market and new Baseball Stadium!!
**STRP PERMIT AVAILABLE UPON REQUEST**

The space
One mile from all the action on Lower Broadway, this stunning newly renovated home will be perfect for your home base doing your stay in Nashville!!
A King and 2 queen Beds each with their own private rooms as well a queen memory foam sleeper sofa, queen memory foam foldaway and comfy daybed with 2 single beds allow for plenty of space and comfort to get a good night's rest after hitting the Honky Tonks.
Large Kitchen with huge expandable dining table. 
3 sofas in living room for ample space.
You will have the home all to yourself along with plenty of parking on the street as well as behind the house.
A keypad with your own unique code allows for convenient access without worries of losing the key!
I will be available 24/7 through email, text or phone call. 
As a rule I will not be there in person at check in/check out but will be
more than happy to meet you in person by request at check-in if you would like a crash course introduction to the area and goings on.

Guest access
Key code will be provided prior to arrival.
Full access to home

Other things to note
Over the top cool place to stay =)
